rounds.strategy: Driver benched. 3W off all tees, 4H from fairway, 3W on par 5s.
rounds.notes: First competitive 9 on SGT. Short game carried the round: holed 18ft (h5), 13ft (h6) and two 6-footers (h7, h9), lagged 38ft and 26ft to tap-in range. Wedges into greens were sharp: 35yd to 6ft, 42yd to 9ft, 26yd to 8ft. Nearly every long shot found rough. Blow-ups on holes 1 and 8 were compounded long-club misses, matching the open-face pattern from sim data.
